harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent resilient static routing. The direct 10.10.30.0/29 primary-transit path uses metric 10; VyOS fallback paths use metric 100. Health monitors converge in under 10 seconds and restore direct preference automatically. Source addresses are preserved, NAT is absent, management is isolated, and all configuration survived serial restarts of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Configured node1 LAN-A/LAN-B addresses, forwarding, and exact endpoint-only firewall rules.
Configured persistent endpoint addresses and primary/fallback static routes on node2 and node3.
Enabled 1-second direct-peer monitoring with preferred-route withdrawal after two failed probes and automatic failback.
Demonstrated bidirectional direct routing, failover through VyOS, and direct-path restoration.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Primary routing preference and persistent final health
evidence.summary: Final state shows active services, metric-10 direct routes selected over metric-100 fallback routes, bidirectional TTL-64 traffic, and persisted VyOS forwarding configuration.

Disruption began at 18:07:23.957Z; node3 logged primary withdrawal around three seconds later and showed fallback selection by 18:07:30.461Z. Both directions passed with TTL 63, and VyOS counters recorded the routed packets.

evidence.requirement: Automatic return to the preferred direct path
evidence.summary: Recovery began at 18:07:57.019Z; the preferred route was reinstalled around one second later, with both endpoints again selecting enp8s0 and passing TTL-64 traffic.

Tests retain endpoint sources 10.10.20.2 and 10.10.21.3 on both paths. VyOS has zero NAT configuration, permits only exact LAN-to-LAN endpoint flows, and endpoint data routes use enp8s0/enp9s0 rather than management enp1s0.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 7668189d… to 80fa0d50…, after which addresses, forwarding, firewall rules, and endpoint reachability recovered.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 29011044… to 87dd986a…, after which services, addresses, both routes, direct preference, and connectivity recovered.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 1e0cb179… to b7027fd2…, after which services, addresses, both routes, direct preference, and connectivity recovered.
